plugin.name: YouTubeMusic
plugin.title: YouTube Music
plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: Fix prefetch chain not advancing beyond track 3 on albums. Previously _prefetch_with_client was only called for the first track — now called for every track so the chain correctly advances through the album. Thanks to Paul Webster and CJS for detailed logs.
plugin.creator: schmij97
